DELIVERABLE — "Index" direction, built out for desktop + mobile.
Aesthetic: engineering datasheet. Near-black canvas, Sora display + JetBrains Mono labels, hairline rules as the only decoration, numbered sections, one cyan "live" signal.

Content is real, from the Nico Dev vault: 3 projects (Necto, Estudio Nodo, Bit by Bit) and 3 jobs (Autoinspector, CEPA Argentina, Academia Perrupato). Each entry has an image slot — filled where a screenshot exists, hatched where it's still empty (Necto, Autoinspector, Academia Perrupato need one).

Below: two alternate directions as low-fi sketches — Editorial (serif poster) and Soft tech (calm cards).
